Package hec.rss.model

Class DownstreamPulseResponse

java.lang.Object
hec.rss.model.DownstreamPulseResponse
public class DownstreamPulseResponse extends Object
Record of response data from a reservoir outlet pulse to a downstream operation location (node). Used in a transent list in DownstreamOp.
